subject: Kickoff: NimbleWorks solution mentorship pilot - scope & first workshop
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chan <sarah.chan@nimbleworks.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: NimbleWorks solution mentorship pilot - scope & first workshop

Hi Sarah —

Great speaking last week. As discussed, we’d like to run a 6-week embedded mentorship pilot with NimbleWorks to co-deliver a solution pack for your implementation teams. Proposed high-level plan: 

- Week 0: alignment & security intake (SSO, sandbox access)
- Week 1: solution workshop (joint SE-led) + runbook handoff
- Weeks 2-5: paired mentorship sessions and office hours
- Week 6: wrap, retention plan, and metrics review

Can you confirm interest and availability for a 90-minute kickoff / workshop the week of May 11? We’ll need:
- Two technical attendees from NimbleWorks (SE + implementation lead)
- Sample config or anonymized data for the workshop (non-production)
- Any internal success metrics you want to validate (time-to-first-ship, first-week usage, etc.)

I’ve attached a one-page pilot scope outline for quick reference and will follow up with a detailed matrix. Jonas will lead the technical workshop on our side. 

If that sounds good I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-work checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: nimbleworks_pilot_onepager.pdf (stub)

From: Sarah Chan <sarah.chan@nimbleworks.com>

Subject: Re: Kickoff: NimbleWorks solution mentorship pilot - scope & first workshop

Thanks Marissa — excited to get this going. NimbleWorks is definitely interested. Quick notes: 

- May 11 works for an afternoon workshop (US/PDT) for our team.
- I’ll loop in our implementation lead (Devin) and Alex (strategy) — they’re on this thread.
- We have a short intake doc that captures current templates and deployment knobs; I attached it.

Pre-asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a sandbox with model variants we’ll be testing? Even a small sample (2-3 variants) is enough.
- High-level SSO expectations so our infra team can pre-approve.

We’ll review the pilot one-pager and get back with any scope tweaks by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Sarah Chan
Head of Partnerships, NimbleWorks
Sarah.Chan@nimbleworks.com

Adding a technical checklist so NimbleWorks infra can move quickly. Short version below — I can expand into the Drive doc if helpful: 

Pre-workshop technical checklist:
- Sandbox creds: please provide contact for sandbox provisioning or we can create scoped API keys.
- Model variants: indicate 2 preferred model ids and max sequence length.
- Example prompts & expected outputs (anonymized).
- SSO: we support SAML2 + OIDC; send your IdP metadata to infra@redwood.com.
- Network: allowlist our egress IPs (I’ll share the list in the Drive doc).

Workshop plan (90 min):
1) 10m introductions + objectives
2) 20m live demo of runtime + caching/quantization knobs
3) 40m hands-on pairing exercise (deploy a template)
4) 20m next steps & office hours schedule

I’ll prepare a short runbook (nimbleworks_mop_v1.pdf) and a SSO checklist (sso_integration_steps.txt) and add them to the shared folder.

—Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
